associates.clause: Specified Persons must make their Associates aware of the requirements of this Policy and take reasonable steps to ensure their Associates comply with those requirements.
associates.reasoning: Associates — spouses, partners, dependent children, co-resident relatives and controlled or significantly influenced companies, trusts and partnerships — are bound throughout the Policy, with the hedging, trading window, margin lending, CFD, stock lending and MAR provisions all extending expressly to 'their Associates'.

tiers.tier_name: Employees, contractors, secondees and directors who are not Specified Persons

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: This Policy applies to all full-time, part-time and casual employees, contractors, secondees, and directors of CBA and its subsidiaries.   Some of the requirements contained in this Policy apply only to the CBA Board directors, certain individuals who have been classified as Specified Persons, and their Associates.
findings.reasoning: The hedging restriction in the Hedging section binds only Specified Persons, and, for vested holdings, only the CBA Board, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives; an employee who is not classified a Specified Person is unaddressed and bound only by the general insider trading prohibition.

findings.question: physical_hedge

Some of the requirements contained in this Policy apply only to the CBA Board directors, certain individuals who have been classified as Specified Persons, and their Associates.
findings.reasoning: The same Hedging section, which draws no distinction between cash and physically settled arrangements, binds only Specified Persons and the narrower CBA Board/Company Secretary/Executive group for vested holdings, leaving an ordinary employee unaddressed.

findings.question: encumber

findings.reasoning: Using Group Securities as security for financing is banned only for Specified Persons under the Additional requirements for Specified Persons; that clause does not bind an employee outside that classification.

findings.reasoning: Margin lending secured against Group Securities is banned only for Specified Persons; the same Additional requirements clause does not reach an employee outside that classification.

findings.reasoning: No clause anywhere addresses financing secured against a derivative rather than the shares themselves, for any tier.

tiers.tier_name: CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: In addition, the CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries, Group Executives, and each of their Associates, must not enter into a transaction that limits the economic risk of their exposure to any vested Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: This clause expressly bans any transaction limiting economic risk on vested Group Securities for the CBA Board, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives, which covers a cash-settled collar or put regardless of settlement method.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: In addition, the CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries, Group Executives, and each of their Associates, must not enter into a transaction that limits the economic risk of their exposure to any vested Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: The same express ban on transactions limiting economic risk of vested Group Securities draws no distinction based on settlement method, so a physically settled collar or put is equally prohibited.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: Specified Persons and their Associates must not: a. use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: This tier is a subset of Specified Persons and so is bound by the express ban on using Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, which is precisely encumbering the shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: Specified Persons and their Associates must not: a. use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: The same clause expressly bans margin loans or other secured financing arrangements using Group Securities as security, covering any borrowing secured against the vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: Specified Persons and their Associates must not: a. use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: The ban is confined to financing that uses the Group Securities themselves as security; it says nothing about a loan secured against a derivative over the shares rather than the shares themselves, and no other clause addresses it.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: enter into contracts for difference or use any instruments or enter any arrangements for short selling or stock lending of Group Securities, except to the extent covered by any of the “Exceptions to Trading Windows” in this Policy.
findings.reasoning: Stock lending of Group Securities is expressly banned for Specified Persons, and so for this narrower tier, subject only to the listed Trading Window exceptions, none of which covers a title-transfer securities loan.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: Specified Persons and their Associates must not: a. use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: The margin lending clause states that a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy, expressly making a lender's enforcement sale of the shares a breach by the employee, regardless of timing.
